examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Je viens vous annoncer une nouvelle.
examples.trans: I'm coming to announce some news to you.

meanings.note: takes ç before a/o: nous annonçons

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
je ne crois pas = I don't think so
dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth
encore une heure = one more hour
also as an answer: Exactement! = That's right!
also alone as an exclamation: Excellent!

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen

examples.text: On fête son anniversaire ce soir.
examples.trans: We are celebrating her birthday tonight.
I'm treating you to the restaurant.

meanings.note: inviter quelqu'un à = to invite someone to

meanings.en: that far, up to that point; until then, so far

examples.text: Il ne fallait pas aller jusque-là.
examples.trans: You shouldn't have gone that far.
Until then, everything was going well.
I just want to see Mathias.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

meanings.en: to dare, have the courage to do something

examples.text: Je n'ose pas lui poser la question.
examples.trans: I don't dare ask him the question.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

examples.trans: How old would you say she is?
I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui... = I'm the one who...

meanings.en: to leave someone, to break up with
meanings.note: elle m'a quitté = she left me

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
Elle a fait un peu de théâtre.
examples.trans: She's done a bit of theatre.

meanings.note: faire du théâtre = to act on stage

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
se vanter de = to brag about

examples.text: Je ne veux pas me vanter.
Il ne cesse de vanter son succès.
examples.trans: He doesn't stop bragging about his success.

meanings.note: + noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
